# WS3 corrected canonical handoff: offline evidence test; append-only research outputs.
import pathlib, json, datetime, subprocess, sys, hashlib, collections
from research.nfl_opportunity_20261115.models import freeze_output, load_packet, GateError, MODELS, VERSION, canonical, sha
from research.nfl_opportunity_20261115.native_ws1 import consume
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
base=root/"reports/nfl_20261115_prospective"
pin=json.loads((base/"source_control/HANDOFF_PIN.json").read_text())
expected="5e17ff057f528a1ee049d38cde80aa3ce295eec15fff7c051ab37508157a5e71"
assert pin["source_control_manifest_sha256"]==expected
path=base/pin["source_control_manifest_relative_path"]
raw=path.read_bytes()
assert sha(raw)==expected
manifest=json.loads(raw)
now=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
# Execute existing identity/hash validator on the real immutable original-source universe.
report=consume(path,expected,base,now)
print("SOURCE_CHECKS",json.dumps(report["source_checks"]),flush=True)
print("MANIFEST_STRUCTURE",json.dumps({"keys":sorted(manifest),"handoff":manifest.get("handoff"),"history_named_keys":[k for k in manifest if any(t in k.lower() for t in ("history","feature","training"))]}),flush=True)
# Locate actual WS1 interchange manifests by content, not an assumed filename.
searched=[]; found=[]; parse_failures=[]
for directory in (base/"source_control",base/"feature_packet",base/"features",root/"research/nfl_opportunity_20261115"):
    if not directory.exists(): continue
    for f in sorted(directory.rglob("*.json")):
        if f.stat().st_size>20_000_000: continue
        try:
            data=f.read_bytes(); obj=json.loads(data)
        except (OSError,ValueError) as exc:
            parse_failures.append({"path":str(f.relative_to(root)),"error":type(exc).__name__}); continue
        searched.append({"path":str(f.relative_to(root)),"sha256":sha(data),"schema":obj.get("schema") if isinstance(obj,dict) else None})
        if isinstance(obj,dict) and obj.get("schema")=="ws1-nfl-pregame-opportunity-v1":
            found.append({"path":str(f.relative_to(root)),"sha256":sha(data)})
print("INTERCHANGE_SEARCH",json.dumps({"searched":searched,"found":found,"parse_failures":parse_failures}),flush=True)
# Genuine single original contract evidence test, without substituting fixture histories.
eligible=next((i for i,c in enumerate(manifest["candidates"]) if c.get("source_certified") and c.get("eligibility_status")=="EXPECTED_STARTER_SOURCE_BACKED"),None)
if eligible is None: eligible=next(i for i,c in enumerate(manifest["candidates"]) if c.get("source_certified"))
single=[r for r in report["rows"] if r["original_row_index"]==eligible]
print("SINGLE_REAL_CONTRACT",json.dumps(single),flush=True)
test=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-m","unittest","research.nfl_opportunity_20261115.test_models","-v"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180)
print("MODEL_TESTS",test.returncode,(test.stdout+"\n"+test.stderr)[-9000:],flush=True)
assert test.returncode==0
report["canonical_handoff_pin_sha256"]=sha((base/"source_control/HANDOFF_PIN.json").read_bytes())
report["evidence_search"]={"searched":searched,"found":found,"parse_failures":parse_failures,"scope":"WS1 source_control and feature directories; project inventory checked separately"}
report["single_real_contract_integration"]={"original_row_index":eligible,"rows":single,"status":"BLOCKED_MISSING_GENUINE_HISTORY" if not found else "INTERCHANGE_REQUIRES_VALIDATION"}
report["counts_by_game_market_model_status"]=[{"game_id":g,"market":s,"model":m,"status":st,"n":n} for (g,s,m,st),n in sorted(collections.Counter((str(r["contract"].get("event_id")),str(r["contract"].get("stat")),r["model"],r["status"]) for r in report["rows"]).items())]
report["model_code_sha256"]={name:sha((root/"research/nfl_opportunity_20261115"/name).read_bytes()) for name in ("models.py","native_ws1.py","test_models.py")}
report["tests"]={"exit_code":test.returncode,"output":test.stdout+"\n"+test.stderr}
report["requested_draws_per_eligible_contract"]=8192
report["actual_forecast_draws"]=0
report["conditioning_note"]="Missing participation probabilities alone need not block conditional forecasts. Genuine prior opportunity histories are absent from this native quote handoff."
report["opportunity_effect"]="Not estimable for actual players without genuine prior-game inputs; no fixture effect substituted."
receipt=freeze_output(report,base/"opportunity_models"/"canonical_evidence_check")
print("IMMUTABLE_RECEIPT",json.dumps(receipt),flush=True)
print("FINAL_COUNTS",json.dumps({k:report[k] for k in ("forecast_at","original_contracts_attempted","forecast_count","abstained_model_contract_rows","reason_code_counts_model_contract_rows")}),flush=True)
